items.label: AI on
items.description: Let plugins send text to a language model.
items.long_description: Off by default: a prompt leaves the plugin and, with a remote provider, your network. Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: AI provider
items.description: Which provider answers: ollama, openai_compatible or anthropic.
items.long_description: Its address and key are set under Bridges.

items.label: AI model
items.description: The model used when a plugin names none.
items.long_description: Empty uses the provider's own default model.

items.label: AI embedding model
items.description: The model used for embeddings when a plugin names none.

items.label: Local AI providers only
items.description: Refuse any provider that runs outside your own machines.
items.long_description: Only ollama counts as local; an OpenAI-compatible server on your own network still counts as remote.

items.label: Most tokens in an answer
items.description: A plugin can ask for fewer, never more.

items.label: Seconds a plugin waits for an answer
items.description: A slower answer is for a queued request.
items.long_description: From 1 to 9: a plugin call is cut off after ten seconds, so this cannot be higher.

items.label: Seconds a queued request may take
items.description: The provider is given up on after this long.
items.long_description: From 10 to 110: a job is stopped when its lease runs out.

items.label: Requests running at once
items.description: More are made to wait, then told the provider is busy.

items.label: Most queued requests
items.description: More are refused until some finish.

items.label: Tokens a day for the organization
items.description: Requests stop for the rest of the UTC day when this many tokens are used. 0 is no limit.

items.label: Tokens a day for each person
items.description: The same, for each person separately. 0 is no limit.
